verification.precondition: Bindings and their exact neutral Questions resolve from one resource inventory.
verification.stimulus: Validate each binding, then diverge one Question constraint graph.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Canonical graphs pass and the divergent cross-resource graph produces a typed semantic issue.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports the literal semantic-equivalence assertion.
verification.forbiddenMutation: Schema validity alone cannot admit a relationship-divergent Question and binding.

behavior: Survey binding semantics prove exact relationship graph equivalence with neutral Question constraints
